metric: Matching first ALFRED vintage MoM change rounded to one decimal percentage point, nearest decimal ROUND_HALF_UP
target: Monthly CPI Core CPI PCE Core PCE PPI numeric published-like MoM figures

onlineExperiment.method: Select convex mixing weights from earlier first-release-index results only; 6 warmup releases; 0/.25/.50/.75/1

limitations: Metric is NOT validated against literal BLS/BEA original news release printed rounded values
Only 14-16 distinct months; inadequate statistical power for reliable superiority claim
Online blending selected using earlier labels only but not validated across new independent multi-year holdout
Does not compare with contemporaneous professional consensus
Does not assess error interval calibration or trading response
